nodes.name: App.vue
nodes.summary: Playground root for the UI package that mounts ButtonDoc inside a full-height themed layout.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the Button Vue component and defines CVA buttonVariants covering variant, size, shape, danger, and ghost compound styles.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses class-variance-authority with a large compoundVariants matrix so danger and ghost override base variant colors.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel that re-exports the Icon Vue component as the named Icon export.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the Input Vue component, CVA inputVariants for size and prefix/suffix padding, and the InputStatus type.
nodes.languageNotes: CVA variants style only the inner input; border and focus states are left to the wrapping container.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports the Select component family plus selectTriggerVariants and types for status, mode, options, and field-name mapping.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry of the UI package: re-exports utilities, theme/ripple composables, and G-prefixed components, plus a GrittyUI Vue plugin that globally registers them.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue plugin install() registers GButton, GIcon, GInput, and GSelect so templates can use g-* tags after app.use(GrittyUI).

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Vite playground bootstrap that creates the Vue app, installs GrittyUI, loads global styles, and mounts App.vue.
